599:t_006:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Fine. Then I'll just go ahead and enjoy myself however I like.」

599:t_006:3.en:
$$葵$$
「Bring it on! We're ready for this, too!」

599:t_006:4.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I'll take you all on at once, $$バルビエル$$!」

599:t_006:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「I'm sick and tired of that creepy smile of yours and that gloomy machine, too!」

599:t_006:6.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Every score I have to settle with you, I'll settle right here, all at once!」

599:t_006:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「The blood of the beast, the mingling of waters, the destination of the wind, the civilization of fire...」

599:t_006:8.en:
$n
「Why would those words come up now...?」

599:t_006:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Let's go, $$ガン・アーレス$$. We'll teach those foolish Earthlings their place!」

599:t_007:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What's going on here...!? My power can't be just this!」

599:t_007:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「True, he wasn't as much of a threat today as he usually is.」

599:t_007:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Did $$セツコ$$'s $$悲しみの乙女$$ seal his power...?」

599:t_007:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That can't be! My hatred is...!」

599:t_008:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Let us admit it, $$バルビエル$$.」

599:t_008:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「So you came to back up $$バルビエル$$!」

599:t_008:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「That is not why. I came to fetch $$バルビエル$$.」

599:t_008:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$サルディアス$$! Damn you!!」

599:t_009:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$サルディアス$$ got shot!」

599:t_009:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What the heck!? Are they fighting each other!?」

599:t_009:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...As I thought, you are underwhelming. At the very least, when I fought you before, you were not like this.」

599:t_009:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「That is not like you, $$バルビエル$$. Getting emotionally invested in the people who pilot a $$ガンダム$$.」

599:t_009:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「Why would that scorpion bastard care about a $$ガンダム$$...!?」

599:t_009:7.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「He must have seen his own circumstances in them.」

599:t_009:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「After all, the true name of $$バルビエル$$'s machine is $$ガン・アーレス$$.」

599:t_009:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ガンダム$$... $$ガンバスター$$... And now $$ガン・アーレス$$, huh...」

599:t_009:11.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Why does $$ノリコ$$'s $$ガンバスター$$ come into this!?」

599:t_009:12.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Why does $$ノリコ$$'s $$ガンバスター$$ come into this!?」

599:t_009:13.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Why does $$ノリコ$$'s $$ガンバスター$$ come into this!?」

599:t_009:14.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「As expected of $$ゼロ$$. It seems you had noticed.」

599:t_009:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I only had a vague idea, though.」

599:t_009:16.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Just as you say. Those machines, $$ガン・アーレス$$ included, are what are known as products of the civilization of fire.」

599:t_009:17.en:
$n
「The blood of the beast, the mingling of waters, the destination of the wind, the civilization of fire...」

599:t_009:18.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「They all point the way to $$シンカ$$. And all of them have gathered in $c, across space and time.」

599:t_009:19.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「The blood of the beast...」

599:t_009:21.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It is the most primal instinct sleeping within humans... To fight in order to live, to win in order to live.」

599:t_009:22.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It seems that by coming into contact with those who walk that path, you awakened the blood within yourselves.」

599:t_009:23.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「So that's the meaning of $$ダンクーガ$$ being passed down...」

599:t_009:24.en:
$$葵$$
「So our wild instincts woke up thanks to my seniors...」

599:t_009:25.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「The mingling of waters...」

599:t_009:27.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Are you talking about $$アクエリオン$$!?」

599:t_009:28.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「A mechanical angel bearing the name of pure water... It signifies different things melting into one and growing clear.」

599:t_009:29.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Human and $$天翅$$... man and woman...」

599:t_009:30.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「And those melt together inside $$アクエリオン$$...」

599:t_009:31.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「The destination of the wind...」

599:t_009:33.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「The spiral coils into a vortex and calls the wind. That wind, following where the heart leads, always seeks new lands and knows not how to stay.」

599:t_009:34.en:
$$シモン$$
「From underground $$ジーハ村$$ to the ends of the galaxy... My $$螺旋力$$ has always smashed through every wall that stood in my way...」

599:t_009:35.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The three so far were brought by visitors from other worlds, through the birth of the multiverse...」

599:t_009:36.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Precisely. The blood of the beast, the mingling of waters, and the destination of the wind were summoned to advance the civilization of fire.」

599:t_009:38.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「And the civilization of fire... That is the very gathering of human wisdom.」

599:t_009:39.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It calls forth battle, and within it humans advance. Overcoming the enemy before them... the obstacles, together with their machines, for the sake of the future they believe in.」

599:t_009:40.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「The proof of that is the machines bearing the name 'Gun'... Now, this world stands at the terminus of the civilization of fire, and that is why you were gathered.」

599:t_009:41.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Yes... In order to advance into a new age.」

599:t_009:42.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ガンダム$$ will guide us...」

599:t_009:43.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ガンバスター$$ will carve out the future...」

599:t_009:45.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「He was also fighting invaders alongside $$ガン・アーレス$$. On an Earth other than this one.」

599:t_009:47.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So $$バルビエル$$ is an Earthling, too...」

599:t_009:48.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「That is correct. Naturally, at the time he did not go by a name like $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$.」

599:t_009:49.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Incidentally, I... was his enemy back then.」

599:t_009:50.en:
$$万丈$$
「So $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$ was fighting the $$サイデリアル$$?」

599:t_009:52.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It was destroyed. By the hands of the $$サイデリアル$$.」

599:t_009:53.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「He is the last survivor of that Earth.」

599:t_009:55.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「His anger and sorrow at that time were sublimated into hatred, and at last he fully awakened the $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$ $$スフィア$$ of $$ガン・アーレス$$.」

599:t_009:56.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Thanks to that, the unit I was in was wiped out, everyone but me.」

599:t_009:57.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see... So he laid his own memories over the $$ガンダム$$, an existence shouldering the same fate of the civilization of fire.」

599:t_009:58.en:
$$シャア$$
「So his hatred faded, and he could not display his usual strength...」

599:t_009:59.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It is only a guess, mind you...」

599:t_009:60.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I have always wondered whether humans are unable to take the emotion called hatred to its very end.」

599:t_009:62.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Time and new encounters heal wounds... And because people can forget hatred... the past, they are able to move forward.」
